Headline: 122,045 Promoter Shares of Sunrise Bank in Auction from Today
Full Content:
The existing promoters of
Sunrise Bank Limited (SRBL)
are auctioning 1,22,045 units of shares to the general public/ institutions from today i.e. 18th Jestha, 2080.
Earlier, the founder shareholders of SRBL had published a notice regarding the auction of their 1,22,045 units of promoter shares on 7th Baisakh. Since no applications were received, the shareholders have again re-published a notice to auction the same 1,22,045 units of shares to the general public from today.
Individual investors, companies, and institutions are eligible to bid for the auction within a period of 7 days from the date of publication of this notice, i.e. 18th Jestha. Rs. 125 is the minimum bid rate. The shareholders should submit their bids at the central office of the bank located at Gairidhara, Kathmandu.

Headline: Sunrise Bank and Shikhar Insurance signs MOU; customers can now have insurance service from day one of account opening
Full Content:
On Falgun 30, 2074 Sunrise Bank and Shikhar Insurance Company signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) in order to facilitate the account holders of the bank by availing them Health Insurance Facility in all saving deposit products. The MOU was signed by Mr. Ratna Raj Bajracharya, CEO of Sunrise Bank and Mr. Dip Prakash Pandey, CEO of Shikhar Insurance Company.
According to the agreement, the account holders of Sunrise Bank can claim upto Rs. 1 lakh or 25% of the annual average saving in the insured’s saving account. Even prior to this, Sunrise bank had accident insurance for its account holder, whereby in case of accident the account holder can claim upto Rs. 5 lakh or 4 times the amount in saving account whichever is less.

So after the signing of MOU, the account holders of Sunrise Bank will be having the privilege of accident insurance and health insurance from day one, says the press statement.

Headline: Siddhartha Investment Growth Scheme 1 closing auction of 49,687 unit promoter shares of Sunrise Bank today
Full Content:
Siddhartha Investment Growth Scheme 1 (SIGS1) is closing its ­auction for promoter shares of Sunrise Bank Limited (SRBL) today (Magh 24, 2074).

SIGS is selling 49,687 units promoter shares as hold by the mutual fund because the fund matured.

The auction was open from Poush 20, 2074 and the bids will be opened to conclude the auction on Magh 25, 2074.

Siddhartha Capital Limited is the issue manager for this auction.

Interested bidders must bid for minimum of 1000 units of shares.

Interested bidders can collect bid forms from Siddhartha Capital Limited, Naxal, Kathmandu and submit their bids within office hours on Magh 24, 2074.

Interested bidders must attach Good for Payment cheque with the application form.

SRBL had earned Rs 59.42 crore in the second quarter of the FY 2074/75.

Headline: Sunrise Bank promoter to sell 45,992 units promoter shares at Rs 362 for its existing promoter shareholders
Full Content:
Sunrise Bank Limited (SRBL) has published a notice stating that one of the promoter shareholder of the bank is going to sell 45,992 units promoter shares at a minimum price of Rs 362.

As per the direction of Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB) for buying or selling promoter shares of the bank, promoter shareholders of the bank should be given the first priority and if the shares are not bought by promoter shareholders only then other person or institution can buy those under the direction of NRB.

If any promoter shareholder is interested to buy promoter shares then the respective person should submit an application at Bank’s central office at Gairidhara within 35 days of the notice published.
